msg.description: Event message. Null when the event has none.

metrics.description: Built-in and custom metric values, such as {"duration": 1.25, "queue_depth": 12}. An empty object when the event has none.

host.description: Host that sent the event. Null when unknown.

EventEnum.description:
* `req-ok` - req-ok
* `req-fail` - req-fail
* `req-trig` - req-trig
* `run` - run
* `complete` - complete
* `fail` - fail
* `ok` - ok
* `pause` - pause
* `tick` - tick
* `logs` - logs
* `skipped` - skipped

client.description: Client that sent the event. Null when unknown.

host.description: Host that sent the event. Null when unknown.

monitors.description: Null unless withMonitorDetails=true, which includes monitor details.

assigned_to.description: Email address of the assigned team member.

assign_to.description: Email address of the assigned team member.

assigned_to.description: Email address of the assigned team member.

duration.description: Returns the total duration of the maintenance window in seconds.

state.description: Returns whether the window is currently past|ongoing|upcoming.

Monitor.description:
V5 serializer replaces 'schedule' with 'schedules' to support multiple schedule expressions.
This is used for monitors with multiple cron expressions or Windows Task Scheduler RRULE triggers.

Also consolidates public_badge_url and public_detailed_badge_url into a 'badges' object.

attributes.description: Values derived from the monitor configuration.

failure_tolerance.description: Failures tolerated before an alert. Default 0.

grace_seconds.description: Seconds to wait after a missed or late event before alerting.

initialized.description: Whether the monitor has received telemetry.

key.description: Unique monitor key. Required when creating a monitor.

latest_event.description: Present when the request has withStatus=true (the default).

latest_events.description: Latest event of each kind, keyed by event name. Present with withEvents=true.

next_expected_at.description: Unix timestamp of the next scheduled run. Null when the monitor has no schedule. May include fractional seconds.

notify.description: Notification list keys or inline destinations such as "email:ops@example.com". Omit to use the default list.

events.description: true alerts on every tick. Otherwise run and complete flags.

passing.description: Present when the request has withStatus=true (the default).

realert_interval.description: How often to repeat an alert, for example "8 hours", or seconds.

request.description: The request a check monitor makes. Required when type is check.

url.description: http(s) URL for an HTTP check, or host:port for TCP and UDP.

method.description: HTTP method, or TCP or UDP.

body.description: Request body. Null when the check sends none.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before the check times out. Free plans allow up to 30; paid plans allow up to 60.

running.description: Present when the request has withStatus=true (the default).

schedules.description: Cron expressions, intervals such as "every 5 minutes", or RRULEs.

schedule_tolerance.description: Missed runs tolerated before an alert. Default 0.

timezone.description: IANA timezone. Defaults to the account timezone.

key.description: Key of the monitor to clone.
